notes.title: Abashed is featured in The Lovecraftian Days 2025 and Indie Game Utsav festival!
notes.notes:
I'm very excited to share that Abashed is featured in the Indie Game Utsav and Lovecraftian Days 2025 festival!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188644/12764b98ad6c7d287bedb40055a26f763c03f627.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/LovecraftianDays2025]Lovecraftian Days[/url] celebrates games that emphasize the terror of the unknown and incomprehensible. The term 'Lovecraftian' is named after the author H. P. Lovecraft, whose work is characterized by these themes.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/ComicConxIndieGameUtsav]Indie Game Utsav[/url] is a celebration of over 100 indie games made in India!

If you haven't had the chance to try out the new extended demo yet, now would be the time! I've also pushed several fixes and quality of life improvements along with the new content based on your feedback.

[h3]What next?[/h3]
I will continue to push fixes and improvements, and more exclusive limited-period content will be available in the future.
Please feel free to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/shfPV8ytn3]Discord community[/url] to see regular dev updates, post bug reports, or chat with me!

[h3]With gratitude,[/h3]
Supantha

notes.title: Discover a Cute, Cozy Idle Game Where Pandas Run a Laundromat!
notes.notes:
Our friends over at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45181686]Destroyer Doggo[/url] have created an adorable and relaxing idle game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3194550/Bao_Baos_Cozy_Laundromat/ ]Bao Bao’s Cozy Laundromat[/url]. Step into the world of Bao Bao, the lovable panda, and manage a bustling laundromat with colorful washing machines, dryers, and panda helpers taking care of the shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188644/922e170cc15b932c768bb9dacfea2d59fe500d88.png[/img]

Customize your space with charming decorations like plants, chairs, vending machines, and even adorable cats! Streamers can engage their audience with built-in Twitch chat support, while multitaskers will love the dock mode, perfect for occasional management while working or relaxing. 

Discover the cozy charm of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3194550/Bao_Baos_Cozy_Laundromat/]Bao Bao’s Cozy Laundromat[/url] today—visit the Steam store page to learn more and grab the game!

notes.title: Abashed Demo Now Available!
notes.notes:
I'm super excited to share that the Abashed demo is now available to play!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188644/7c748c8bc1877801a9b98325b07635a9e61e2e56.png[/img]

The demo provides a glimpse of what you can expect from the game. A bigger demo is on its way and will be available by the end of next month!
The game is as much about Issac's journey as it is about my own—a story of pushing through uncertainty and embracing vulnerability to uncover hidden truths. I hope you find yourself as immersed in this world as I was in creating it.

[h3]What now?[/h3]
If you face any issues while playing the demo, have any suggestions, or simply want to talk about it, please feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/shfpv8ytn3]Discord[/url] community! 

[h3]With gratitude,[/h3]
Supantha Paul
